hearth.roads.greet.pedlar.0: Needles, ribbons, salt from the coast - cheaper than in town!
hearth.roads.greet.pedlar.1: A buyer on the road, God be thanked. My feet were growing tired of no one.
hearth.roads.greet.pedlar.2: Mind the cart, friend. Everything in it is for sale, the cart excepted.
hearth.roads.greet.pilgrim.1: Pray for us at the shrine, if you pass it before we do.
hearth.roads.greet.pilgrim.2: Peace be with you. Is it far yet to %s?
hearth.roads.greet.messenger.0: Make it quick - I have word to carry.
hearth.roads.greet.messenger.1: Out of the way - word for the reeve of %s!
hearth.roads.greet.messenger.2: If it's news you're after, you'll get none from me.
hearth.roads.greet.carter.0: Easy, girl... the ford's high today.
hearth.roads.greet.carter.1: Same road, same mule, same ruts. What can I do for you?
hearth.roads.greet.carter.2: If you're walking to %s, you'll be there before me.
hearth.roads.greet.patrol.0: Road's quiet as far as the old oak. Keep your eyes open after dark.
hearth.roads.greet.patrol.1: Halt there. Your business on this road?
hearth.roads.greet.patrol.2: Travelling alone? Then travel by daylight.
hearth.roads.greet.guard.0: Keep your distance from the wagon, friend.
hearth.roads.greet.guard.1: Hands where I can see them, and we'll get on fine.
hearth.roads.greet.guard.2: No closer. We've had trouble on this road before.
hearth.roads.greet.trader.0: Good day. If you've coin and want goods, %s is where we'll sell them.
hearth.roads.greet.trader.1: Every day on this road costs me money. Speak.
hearth.roads.greet.trader.2: A fair road today. Let us hope it stays that way.
hearth.roads.greet.market.0: Off to market in %s. Eggs, cabbages, a little cheese.
hearth.roads.greet.market.1: Market day! Prices won't be what they ought, but they never are.
hearth.roads.greet.market.2: We started before light and we're still not there.
hearth.roads.greet.settler.0: We're bound for new land at %s. Pray it's better than the old.
hearth.roads.greet.settler.1: Everything we own is on that cart.
hearth.roads.greet.settler.2: New fields, new walls, new neighbours. God help us.
hearth.roads.greet.traveller.1: Long road, short temper. What is it?
hearth.roads.say.camp.0: Sit, warm yourself. Roads are no place to be alone at night.
hearth.roads.say.camp.1: We'll be off at first light. Tonight it's the fire and the stars.
hearth.roads.say.camp.2: Quietly now. Some of us are trying to sleep.
hearth.roads.say.bound.pedlar: To %s, for the market. Then on to the next one, and the next.
hearth.roads.say.bound.pilgrim: To the holy place at %s. We'll walk back on the feast's light.
hearth.roads.say.bound.carter: To %s and back before dark, same as every day.
hearth.roads.say.bound.guard: To %s, with the wagon. Where else?
hearth.roads.say.bound.trader: To %s. They're short of what I carry, and they'll pay for it.
hearth.roads.say.bound.settler: To %s. There's land there nobody has broken yet.
hearth.roads.say.bound.patrol: To the edge of %s's land and back. We walk it every day.
hearth.roads.say.carry.cargo: %s, mostly. And that's all you need to know.
hearth.roads.say.carry.market: What the garden gave. It'll sell or it'll rot.
hearth.roads.say.carry.pilgrim: Only our prayers, and bread enough for the road.
hearth.roads.say.carry.messenger: A letter for %s. Sealed, and staying that way.
hearth.roads.say.carry.pedlar: A little of everything. Ask what you want to buy.
hearth.roads.say.carry.patrol: A sword, and the right to use it.
hearth.roads.say.news.built: In %s they finished the %s. Fine work, they say.
hearth.roads.say.news.tier: %s is a %s now, if you can believe it.
hearth.roads.say.news.short: In %s they're short of %s. They'll pay for it, if you have it.
hearth.roads.say.news.arrived: %s came to live in %s. Nobody knows much about them yet.
hearth.roads.say.news.left: Folk from %s went off to found %s.
hearth.roads.say.news.founded: There's a new place called %s. Little more than a fire and some stakes.
hearth.roads.say.ahead.bandits.0: Bandits past the %s, they say. I'd not go that way after dark.
hearth.roads.say.ahead.bandits.1: There's a band holding the road beyond the %s. Pay them, or go round.
hearth.roads.say.ahead.bandits.2: A man was robbed by the %s three nights ago. Keep your purse light.
hearth.roads.say.ahead.patrolled: The watch walked it this morning. Quiet enough.
hearth.roads.say.ahead.quiet: Quiet, as far as I've seen.
hearth.roads.say.ahead.quiet.0: Quiet, as far as I've seen.
hearth.roads.say.ahead.quiet.1: Mud and ruts, nothing worse. Not by day, at least.
hearth.roads.say.pedlar.poor: Your purse is lighter than your boots, friend. Come back when it isn't.
hearth.roads.say.pedlar.sold.0: A fine %s. You'll not find better in any town.
hearth.roads.say.pedlar.sold.1: Sold! The %s is yours, and good luck to it.
hearth.roads.fund: I'd like to pay toward the road to %s (%s)
hearth.roads.fund.thanks.0: God bless you. The road to %s will be the sooner for it.
hearth.roads.fund.thanks.1: That's another furlong of road to %s, near enough. Thank you.
hearth.roads.fund.thanks.2: The crew will hear of it. The road to %s thanks you.
hearth.roads.bandit.demand.1: Nice boots. Nicer purse, I'd wager.
hearth.roads.bandit.demand.2: Lay it on the stone and walk on.
hearth.roads.bandit.demand.3: Toll road, this. Pay the toll.
hearth.roads.bandit.paid: Wise. On your way - and don't look back.
hearth.roads.bandit.cant_pay: Can't even pay? Then we'll take it off your corpse.
hearth.roads.bandit.talked: ...Fine. Go on, before I change my mind.
hearth.roads.bandit.away.2: Off with you, before we change our minds.
hearth.roads.bark.pedlar.0: Needles, ribbons, salt from the coast - cheaper than in town!
hearth.roads.bark.pedlar.1: Thread and buttons! Knives sharpened, almost!
hearth.roads.bark.pedlar.2: Something for your sweetheart? Something for your mother?
hearth.roads.bark.pedlar.3: The best wares between here and the sea!
hearth.roads.bark.pedlar.5: Market tomorrow, and I'll be there first.
hearth.roads.bark.pedlar.6: Pins! Combs! A mirror to see your own face in!
hearth.roads.bark.pedlar.7: I was in Coldbrook yesterday and I'll be somewhere else tomorrow.
hearth.roads.bark.pedlar.8: Buy something, or help me push.
hearth.roads.bark.pedlar.10: A ribbon for luck on the road?
hearth.roads.bark.pedlar.11: Last of the good salt. Going, going...
hearth.roads.bark.pilgrim.0: Pray for us at the shrine, if you pass it before we do.
hearth.roads.bark.pilgrim.1: Our Father, who art in heaven...
hearth.roads.bark.pilgrim.2: My feet are a penance all their own.
hearth.roads.bark.pilgrim.3: God keep you on the road.
hearth.roads.bark.pilgrim.4: One more hill, they said. Three hills ago.
hearth.roads.bark.pilgrim.6: The saint's bones are said to heal the lame. We'll see.
hearth.roads.bark.pilgrim.7: Walk with us a while, if you're going our way.
hearth.roads.bark.pilgrim.8: I promised my mother I'd make this journey.
hearth.roads.bark.pilgrim.10: They say the shrine glows on the feast night.
hearth.roads.bark.pilgrim.11: Bless you, traveller. Mind the dogs ahead.
hearth.roads.bark.messenger.0: Out of the way - word for the reeve!
hearth.roads.bark.messenger.4: If this horse throws a shoe, I'm finished.
hearth.roads.bark.messenger.7: Is this the road to the ford?
hearth.roads.bark.carter.0: Easy, girl... the ford's high today.
hearth.roads.bark.carter.1: Walk on. Walk on, you stubborn thing.
hearth.roads.bark.carter.2: Every rut on this road knows my name.
hearth.roads.bark.carter.3: There and back before dark, God willing.
hearth.roads.bark.carter.8: That axle won't last the winter.
hearth.roads.bark.carter.9: If it rains, we're stuck to the hubs.
hearth.roads.bark.carter.10: Market's tomorrow - got to be there early.
hearth.roads.bark.carter.11: She knows the way better than I do.
hearth.roads.bark.patrol.0: Road's quiet as far as the old oak. Keep your eyes open after dark.
hearth.roads.bark.patrol.3: Seen anyone skulking in the trees?
hearth.roads.bark.patrol.4: Another day, another mile of mud.
hearth.roads.bark.patrol.7: We've had word of a band in the woods.
hearth.roads.bark.patrol.8: State your business on this road.
hearth.roads.bark.patrol.10: Back to town before the bell.
hearth.roads.bark.patrol.11: If you see anything, tell the captain.
hearth.roads.bark.caravan.0: Keep your distance from the wagon, friend.
hearth.roads.bark.caravan.4: We make the next town by nightfall or we camp.
hearth.roads.bark.caravan.5: One more wheel like that and we'll be walking.
hearth.roads.bark.caravan.7: Watch the wheels on this rut!
hearth.roads.bark.caravan.8: Half a day to town, if the horses hold.
hearth.roads.bark.caravan.9: Nobody rides ahead without my say.
hearth.roads.bark.caravan.11: This load's worth more than your hide, friend.
hearth.roads.bark.traveller.1: Fine weather for walking. For once.
hearth.roads.bark.traveller.2: Is this the road to town?
hearth.roads.bark.traveller.5: Don't stop on the road after dark, friend.
hearth.roads.bark.traveller.7: Have you come from the town ahead?
hearth.roads.bark.traveller.8: Is the inn ahead any good?
hearth.roads.bark.traveller.9: I'd not walk this road at night.
hearth.roads.bark.traveller.10: Mind the mud by the ford.
hearth.roads.bark.crew.0: Set them square - we're building a road, not a goat track!
hearth.roads.bark.crew.1: More gravel! Who's on the cart?
hearth.roads.bark.crew.2: Another furlong and they'll be able to see us from town.
hearth.roads.bark.crew.3: Dig it deeper. The first rain will tell if you didn't.
hearth.roads.bark.crew.4: Mind your feet, traveller - the bed's soft here.
hearth.roads.bark.crew.5: If you've a coin for the road, the reeve takes it gladly.
hearth.roads.bark.crew.7: Stones in, then gravel, then pray.
hearth.roads.bark.crew.9: Mind the line. Straight as a furrow.
hearth.roads.bark.crew.10: A road lasts a hundred years, if you build it right.
